_doc: Scope picks — namespaced by data type. Each generator reads its own namespace: tiles.nu reads .tiles, paint.nu reads .paints, etc. Hand-edited. Generators emit specs/_partials/<type>-quantity-<scope-id>.md.
_scope_id_rule: scope id is kebab-case; matches the output filename suffix (e.g. 'bathroom-basic' → tile-quantity-bathroom-basic.md, 'house-exterior-concrete' → paint-quantity-house-exterior-concrete.md).

bathroom-basic.title: Bathroom — tile quantities (BASIC)
bathroom-basic.notes: Existing bathroom (no wall move). Pemo R11 — wet zone safe.

bathroom-compact.title: Bathroom — tile quantities (COMPACT)
bathroom-compact.notes: Existing bathroom (no wall move). Tiled walls = the 3-sided shower box plus a small splashback behind the basin. Same tile as BASIC for cross-spec consistency.

bathroom-enlarge.title: Bathroom — tile quantities (ENLARGE)
bathroom-enlarge.notes: Bathroom enlarged via wall move; the spec calls for two walls tiled — the long fixture wall (3.0 m, full bathroom length) and the back wall of the wet zone (1.35 m, end wall opposite the door). Cabinet wall and door wall stay painted. Confirm wall heights on site if 2.1 m doesn't match the actual ceiling line.

house-wide.title: Whole-house floor tiles (excluding bathroom)
house-wide.notes: Cross-room flooring for the SPA's tiles/SPEC.md (parent repo). Marbella DGDV is glossy — fine on dry floors. Not consumed by any quick/specs/* file yet.

house-exterior-concrete.title: House exterior concrete — paint quantities
house-exterior-concrete.notes: Existing house plaster + perimeter fence. Old house, dusty/chalky in places — primer designed for this.

house-exterior-timber.title: House exterior timber — paint quantities
house-exterior-timber.notes: Eaves + fascia around the roof line.
